Meet Loren

Hi, I’m Loren Sofía

I’m a Functional Fertility Practitioner (FNTP, FDN-P, RCPC, CPPC) and the founder of Innate Fertility.

After coming off hormonal birth control, I went looking for answers about my own fertility, and that search took me to nutritional therapy school. Today 87.3k people follow along on Instagram, and I host the Innate Wisdom Podcast.

This masterclass is the starting point of the work I do with women and couples.
